purpose: Teach: 人的/地上波/成り立ち/林業/沼/沿線/練っ/質感

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、人的資源論、丁寧に書きましたね。
lines.en: Your paper on HR theory—you wrote it with real care, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observational opening. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone noticing genuine effort. Slight upward lift on the question, inviting him to receive the compliment.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。地上波放送局の戦略、章にしました。
lines.en: Yes. I made the terrestrial broadcasters' strategy the focus of one chapter.
lines.style: Clear and direct. A small breath before the key point. Respectful, attentive—meeting her gaze. Not performing, just answering honestly.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 業界の成り立ち、歴史を踏まえて、論じましたね。
lines.en: And you grounded it in the industry's history—how it actually came to be. That was solid.
lines.style: Engaged, nodding slightly. Warm approval without overstatement. A teacher who recognizes when a student has done the homework right. Measured pace, genuine interest.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。林業の衰退、別章で扱いました。
lines.en: Yes. I gave forestry decline its own section—separate treatment.
lines.style: Quiet confidence. A pause before naming it, like he's checking his own reasoning. Steady, not rushing. The feeling of someone who knows what he found matters.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 地方の沼、生態系、興味深い切り口でしたね。
lines.en: The regional ecosystem angle—the way you framed it was genuinely fresh.
lines.style: Leaning forward slightly. Slower, more deliberate pace. Real recognition in the voice. Not flattery—specific, earned praise for thinking differently.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 沿線開発と、地域経済、連動論じました。
lines.en: I connected the development along the rail lines to the local economy—showed how they move together.
lines.style: Steady, methodical. A small breath between the two halves—connecting them visibly. Not rushed. The clarity of someone who has thought this through completely.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 仮説を練った過程、章末で添えていますね。
lines.en: And you included your working process at the end of each chapter—the hypothesis development.
lines.style: Gentle recognition. A slight lean, like she's looking at something he's done that surprised her in a good way. Warm, admiring tone. Not quite a question, but open enough to let him respond.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 文化財の質感、写真資料で示しました。
lines.en: I used photographs to show the texture and quality of the heritage materials themselves.
lines.style: Quiet pride, briefly. A small breath. Professional, but there's something genuine underneath—the feeling of someone who has found the right way to say something difficult. Slightly softer at the close.
